releases.headline: Field guides for more places

items.title: Three new field guides
items.detail: Pacific Northwest, New York and South Louisiana join the Atlas, each with its own edition of patches: Evergreen, Borough and Bayou.
items.try: In Settings, open Field-guide downloads and download the one nearest you.

items.title: Patches for every region
items.detail: San Diego, SF Bay Area, California Deserts and Orlando & Space Coast now have a patch, a story and a silhouette for every bird.
items.try: Update those field guides in Field-guide downloads, then open one of their sets in the Atlas.

items.title: Quicker photos from your glasses
items.detail: Capture a sighting on the lens now takes the photo at once, and each tap takes another. They cross to your phone, where you name them.
items.try: On a glasses run, choose Capture a sighting, tap for a few photos, then name them on your phone.

items.title: See the whole photo
items.detail: In Name this bird, tap the photo to open it full screen, then pinch or double-tap to zoom in on the bird.
items.try: Capture a sighting, then tap the photo before you choose its name.

items.title: Smoother all round
items.detail: Photos from your glasses arrive at full detail, and the capture camera no longer shows a stray 0.9× zoom button.

releases.note: Seen something odd? Take a screenshot in the app and choose Share Beta Feedback.

releases.headline: Add the birds you see

items.title: Capture a sighting
items.detail: Photograph a bird you saw but didn’t hear, or pick a photo from your library, and it counts as a sighting. It works during a run or with no run at all.
items.try: On Listen, tap Capture a sighting, photograph a bird, then choose its name.

items.title: Name it now or later
items.detail: Name this bird offers the birds heard on your run and likely nearby first. In a hurry? Name it later keeps the photo under To name in your Collection.
items.try: Take a photo, tap Name it later, then name it from To name in Collection’s Sightings.

items.title: From your glasses too
items.detail: The lens has its own Capture a sighting row: take the photo, say the bird’s name, and it’s added without reaching for your phone.
items.try: On a glasses run, choose Capture a sighting on the lens and say the bird’s name.

items.title: Change a sighting’s bird
items.detail: Named the wrong bird? A sighting you named has Change bird on its page, and its patch follows to the right species.
items.try: Open a sighting you named, tap Change bird and choose another.

items.title: Smoother all round
items.detail: Switching between Patches, Sightings and Species in your Collection lands every time, and this card will tell you what’s new after each update.

releases.note: Seen something odd? Take a screenshot in the app and choose Share Beta Feedback.

releases.headline: Guilds open their doors

items.title: Guilds are open
items.detail: Sign in to start a Guild with friends and see each other’s finds as they happen.
items.try: Start a Guild, send its invite to another tester, then each add a bird.

items.title: Sew a patch from the run
items.detail: Every bird heard on a run has its own Sew it or Add button, and the list holds still under your finger.
items.try: Start a run near some birdsong and sew a patch straight from its row.

items.title: Listen follows where you are
items.detail: The painting on Listen and the app’s accent colour match the region you’re birding in.

items.title: A quicker, clearer start
items.detail: The app opens faster, and a slow start says your journal is on its way.

releases.note: Seen something odd? Take a screenshot in the app and choose Share Beta Feedback.
